jobPostingInfo.title: Surgical Technologist Internship
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
SUMMARY

Learning how to be a great Surgical Technologist extends far beyond the classroom. Our program is designed specifically for Surgical Tech students. Rochester Regional Health is dedicated to providing outstanding experiences to students in the Rochester area.

The internship provides students with vital experience that will enhance the remainder of their college education and assist in their transition into their profession.


HOW WE CARE FOR YOU

  • New Graduate Signing Bonus
  • Student Loan Repayment Program
  • Employee Referral Program with Bonuses
  • Same Day Pay through DailyPay
  • Free Parking
  • Employee Discount Programs

The Internship Program Features:

  • A 6 week paid internship
  • The opportunity to work 40 hours a week
  • Weekly educational opportunities
  • Networking opportunities

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Enrollment in an accredited Surgical Technology Program required
  • High school graduate or equivalent preferred
  • One (1) year patient care and/or operating room experience n an accredited hospital preferred
  • Basic computer skills
  • Demonstrate understanding of aseptic techniques


LOCATIONS:

  • Rochester General Hospital
  • Unity Hospital
  • Newark Wayne Community Hospital
  • Clifton Springs Hospital & Clinic
  • United Memorial Medical Center

STATUS:               6-week internship program starting on June 14th, 2027.

DEPARTMENT: Perioperative
